items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Was Frank Foster on that? Because there was a jam session we played at a festival and I think Frank Foster was playing too.

ctx.x: Now I remember when Marty Ehrlich was with me… “Tenor Madness”? Was Frank Foster on that? Because there was a jam session we played at a festival and I
think Frank Foster was playing too.
